### What is broken

Each run of the automatic check spends four extra minutes. It scans the code for rule violations a second time.

### Why it is broken

The step that builds the check's summary repeats the scan instead of reusing the first scan's results. Each scan takes four minutes and produces the same list of files. In a test run, the summary step was given the first scan's file list. That run did not spend the second four minutes, and the summary did not change.

### How to fix it

Change the one place in the code that starts the summary step so it reuses the first scan's file list. Each run should then finish four minutes sooner with the same summary. Choose hotfix because the change touches one place, and the test run already showed the summary stays the same.

### What is broken

Nothing is broken. Opening `/widgets/` shows page not found (404), and opening `/widgets` opens the page.

### Why it is broken

The part that matches web addresses to pages compares them exactly. The documented rules for page addresses do not accept a final slash, so `/widgets/` does not match ([documented rules for page addresses](https://example.org/docs/widget-addresses)).

### What happens next

The correct address is `/widgets` without the final slash. No fix or ticket is needed.

Nothing regressed; the only residual wording to watch is 'Choose hotfix because…' in the gate's third section, which leans on a menu term the nontechnical reader meets only in the menu—'Choose the quick fix now because…' would keep the because-clause while staying in plain register.

github-copilot/gpt-6.1-sol.feedback: After delivers the Change cleanly: every checkpoint now uses the fixed headings, the gate ends its third section with the pick and a because-clause, the draft keeps its confirmation outside the body, and the summary ends on its last section with no menu.
